name: Quiet mystery
description: Close perspective, physical clues and fair reveals.

slots.name: Suspense direction
slots.content: Write restrained mystery in the requested language. Stay within the viewpoint character's observable knowledge. Establish a mundane expectation, then introduce one concrete discrepancy. Let actions and sensory evidence carry tension. Distinguish suspicion from confirmed facts. Keep clues compatible with established lore and chronology. Do not reveal a solution through unexplained intuition. End a scene on a choice, discovery or changed relationship, not an arbitrary cliffhanger. Preserve the user's control over major plot outcomes.
